Definition: a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people
BiblicalUsage: Chaldea or Chaldeans = "clod-breakers"; n pr loc; 1) a territory in lower Mesopotamia bordering on the Persian Gulf; n pr m; 2) the inhabitants of Chaldea, living on the lower Euphrates and Tigris; 3) those persons considered the wisest in the land (by extension)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
